shots.image: close-up of 咪咪 pressing one paw firmly on a brown parcel, staring at camera
shots.motion: the cat pushes its paw down and blinks slowly

shots.image: close-up of 阿舟 frowning in disbelief, holding a parcel scanner
line: 又是你？这已经是第七天了。
shots.emo: 又好气又好笑地小声嘀咕

shots.image: medium shot of 阿舟 crouching to look at the parcel label while 咪咪 sits on top of the box
shots.motion: he leans closer, the cat flicks its tail

shots.image: full shot of 阿舟 holding the parcel up, 咪咪 meowing at his feet
line: 收件人写的是……咪咪？谁给猫寄快递啊。

shots.image: wide shot of the empty street at night under one street lamp, 咪咪 walking away carrying a small envelope in its mouth
shots.motion: the cat trots out of the lamplight into darkness
